_comment: TestNexus Claude Code hook. Copy this into .claude/settings.json in your project root. After every successful './gradlew assembleDebug' (or any Bash command that outputs 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL'), the hook runs 'testnexus push' automatically, which validates and uploads the APK to the TestNexus app on your phone.

hooks.command: if grep -q 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" 2>/dev/null && command -v testnexus >/dev/null 2>&1; then testnexus push 2>&1 || true; fi
